name: whaley
ritual: Comment 'I HEAR HIM' if you'd stay the night

slides.text: THEY BUILT THIS HOUSE ON THE GALLOWS
San Diego, 1852. A man called 'Yankee Jim' Robinson was hanged here for stealing a boat.
Thomas Whaley watched the hanging. A few years later, he bought the land.
In 1857 he finished the city's first two-story brick house, right on the gallows site.
It became a store, a theater, even the county courthouse.
And the family heard heavy footsteps upstairs when no one was there. They decided it was Yankee Jim.
Today it's a museum. Visitors still report footsteps.
